items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And my uncle, Philip(?) Reed, he bought an alto saxophone

ctx.x: But anyway, I didn't have an instrument. And my uncle, Philip(?) Reed, he bought an alto saxophone with the intention, you know, of doing big things, and he gave it up after a while -- he didn't stay with it. So my mother made a deal with him to wash and iron his clothes to pay for the saxophone. And he agreed to let me have it, you know. So then I had my own instrument.
